standing_rules: Read RULES.md on main and this state at chat start.
GitHub is the default repository editing control plane; ask the user only for VAX compile/link/RMS/live acceptance when needed.
Omit OVMS-AGENT> from agent command lines.
Use GITAUTH for Git network operations.
Canonical acceptance requires All regression tests passed and %X00000001 when a product build is required.
Do not call an untested GitHub candidate or promoted merge VAX-green.
Promotion wording must distinguish a separately VAX-accepted code/content head from a GitHub merge SHA unless the merge SHA itself was run on VAX.
